definitions.explanation: A Buddhist temple of one of the Zen schools, such as Rinzai or Soto, where monks practise seated meditation ({座禅|ざぜん}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{禅寺|ぜんでら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねた→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧。
examples.english: I visited a Zen temple in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {禅寺|ぜんでら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{座禅|ざぜん}→座禅：09641_zazen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}した→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧。
examples.english: I tried Zen meditation at a Zen temple.

examples.japanese: {禅寺|ぜんでら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{枯山水|かれさんすい}→枯山水：31414_karesansui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The Zen temple has a dry landscape garden made only of stones and sand.

notes:
⟦{禅|ぜん}→禅：03757_zen⟧ (Zen) + ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧, with rendaku: でら. Well-known Zen temples include Ryoan-ji and Kennin-ji in Kyoto and Engaku-ji in Kamakura.
